partners.about_text: Neurons Tech — Designing Digital Systems that Make Sense At Neurons Tech, we believe that technology should do more than work.It should fit, connect, and endure. We design digital systems grounded in how organizations truly operate — not just in how software behaves. Our work starts with real business needs, workflows, and dependencies, and leads to clean architecture, reliable data flows, and intuitive operations. Technology should serve people, processes, and decisions — not the other way around. We approach every project as a system, where people, data, and processes must function as a coherent whole. Our delivery follows the Product-Oriented Delivery (POD) model, with small, cross-functional teams owning features from concept to deployment. This ensures clarity of ownership, speed, accountability, and continuous iteration in complex digital environments. At Neurons Tech, we don’t just deliver software. We define how organizations work and translate that understanding into scalable, future-ready digital systems. Our leadership brings this approach to life, combining systems architecture with business operations to align strategy, structure, and execution. Our implementations include myDATA & AADE compliance through licensed electronic invoicing providers (B2C, B2B, B2G) POS integrations with providers such as epay, Viva and others Loyalty strategy systems , including customer-facing minisites Custom warehouse and inventory modules , aligned with Greek legislation Electronic Shelf Label (ESL) solutions through our proprietary Tagora platform Beyond standard implementations, we deliver fully custom Odoo modules and integrations , tailored to each organization’s operational reality. Designed to Evolve We closely follow the Greek market and regulatory landscape. Our systems are designed to adapt, evolve, and grow as needs and legislation change. As an Official Odoo Partner , we build solutions that go beyond implementation — systems that are understood, reliable, and built to last.
